sinopsis.es: En una pequeña ciudad de Hunan, tras el colapso del auge inmobiliario, el Tío 3 decidió abandonar este mundo. Un documental familiar filmado durante siete años recorre los edificios inacabados de nuestra ciudad y reconstruye fragmentos de su vida. Su alma se funde con esas estructuras incompletas, suspendida en un tiempo detenido.
sinopsis.en: In a small city in Hunan, after the collapse of the real estate boom, Uncle 3 chose to leave this world. A home documentary filmed over seven years haunts the unfinished buildings of our hometown, recounting fragments of his life. His soul merges with these incomplete structures, suspended in a stalled time, as if nothing had ever happened.
